brief: Outline a small device-care information event for a fictional local repair and trade-in service.
result: Run a short device-care Q&A with a preparation checklist and separate optional assessment appointments. Publish a clear event description with the real date, location and booking conditions once those details are confirmed.
rationale: EPA guidance supports the preparation topic. Google Business Profile supports event posts; neither source establishes demand or promises attendance.
considerations: Keep the example unscheduled. Confirm capacity, accessibility and battery-handling arrangements before announcing an event.

sources.title: EPA: Electronics Donation and Recycling
sources.statement: EPA guidance recommends deleting personal information before donating or recycling electronics and handling batteries separately when appropriate.

sources.title: Google Business Profile: Create and manage posts
sources.statement: Business Profile posts can communicate updates, offers and events to customers on Google.
